title: Route Activation Contract
description: Typed, verifiable contract that separates primary route, secondary routes, cross-cutting disciplines, and audits. Audit evidence uses the shared typed-reference vocabulary and is re-verified at delivery. Designed for embedding in Markdown ```contract fenced blocks.

artifact_id.description: Stable artifact identifier shared with the Research Pack and report (issue #376). Recommended; required under --strict.

contract_version.description: Schema/manifest version this contract was generated against (e.g., "1"). Recommended; required under --strict.

created_at.description: Generation timestamp (ISO 8601 date, e.g., 2026-08-13). Recommended; required under --strict.

closest_alternative.description: Canonical id of the closest alternative route considered and rejected. Must belong to primary_route's often_confused_with set in route-manifest.json.

boundary_judgment.description: Why the primary route was chosen over the closest alternative. Required when closest_alternative is set.

checked_conditions.description: Hard-fail conditions of the alternative route that were checked

why_not_alternative.description: Why the alternative route's conditions do not apply to this task

switch_conditions.description: Under what conditions the route should be switched to the alternative

secondary_routes.description: Specialized routes used as secondary — each has independent hard-fail verification. Must be route ids (NOT discipline ids).

disciplines.description: Cross-cutting disciplines applied to this task. These are NOT routes and NOT secondary routes.

audits.description: Verification actions run against the final artifact or process artifact

id.description: Audit identifier. Must exist in schemas/audit-registry.json, or be a derived '<secondary>-secondary-hard-fail' entry for a declared secondary route.

evidence.description: Typed reference to a concrete evidence location. Legacy free-form strings are compatibility-only and cannot pass strict validation.

reason.description: Required for skipped, not_run, or partial audits.

boundary_judgment.why_not_alternative: Task requires investment-style judgment with valuation, not just positioning classification
boundary_judgment.switch_conditions: If the task shifts from investment memo to pure tier classification without valuation burden
